name: 80916 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80916 (Colorado Spgs) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80916 (Colorado Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80916 (Colorado Spgs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
